meta.name: deploy-to-vercel
meta.description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

copy.tagline: 一键将应用部署到 Vercel 并获取链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将应用快速部署到 Vercel 并获取预览链接
copy.tagline_en: Deploy your app to Vercel and get a live link with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently deploy apps to Vercel and need instant preview URLs

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会检查项目是否已关联 Vercel、是否安装 CLI 等，然后选择最合适的方式部署到 Vercel，并返回预览链接。默认部署为预览版，除非你明确要求生产环境。
howto.when: 当你提出部署请求，例如“部署我的应用”、“部署并给我链接”、“推送上线”或“创建预览部署”时触发。

say.text: 部署这个项目到 Vercel，给我预览链接。
say.note: Claude 会检查状态并选择最佳方式部署。

say.text: 把这个网站推上线，用 git push 部署。
创建一个预览部署，不要发布到生产环境。
say.note: Claude 会确保部署为预览版。

howto.what_en: Claude checks if the project is linked to Vercel, if the CLI is installed, etc., then chooses the best method to deploy to Vercel and returns a preview URL. It deploys as preview by default unless you explicitly ask for production.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel and give me the preview link.
say_en.note: Claude will check state and choose the best method.

say_en.text: Push this site live using git push deployment.
say_en.note: If linked with git remote, Claude will commit and push.

say_en.text: Create a preview deployment, not production.
say_en.note: Claude ensures it's a preview deployment.
